findings.summary: The cssText and innerHTML paths each carried their own recursive static-fragment/template collector and their own string-or-number substitution emitter. Both now use collectUiStringParts and uiTemplateSubstitutionCpp, while retaining the markup-only JavaScript string-fallback arm.

ui_toggle_class used attributes["class"] during a probe, which inserted an empty attribute on a no-op, and rebuilt an already-present class at the end of the token list. It now reads without insertion, preserves existing order, and returns when the requested membership already holds; repeated remove() calls likewise stop before incrementing the retained-tree revision.

UiRenderRecorder::begin_frame assigned a fresh aggregate every frame and discarded all four vector capacities. It now clears the retained vectors and updates dimensions in place, preserving output while avoiding recurring allocation churn.

A regenerated retained-canvas texture receives a new recorder id, but every SDL_GPU and Dawn consumer cached old ids until shutdown. All four consumers now evict textures absent from the self-contained current frame, and the shared ui_frame_uses_texture predicate keeps that lifetime rule in the backend-neutral contract.

UiRenderDraw carries nearest_sampling, but the two standalone SpriteRenderer consumers ignored it while the scene consumers honored it. The sprite SDL_GPU and Dawn paths now own both linear and nearest samplers/groups and select them from the same draw flag, with source-shape coverage across all four consumers.

The sweep exposed capture_ui being declared in UI-disabled SDL sprite builds even though its only use is within the UI feature guard. The declaration now shares that guard, preserving UI behavior while keeping minimal sprite configurations warning-clean.
